name: Schmidt astrograph (Schmidt camera)
definition: Catadioptric imaging telescope with a full-aperture Schmidt corrector and a spherical primary that forms the image on a camera at prime focus inside the tube, with no eyepiece position.
reason: Provisional, from memory: no design kind holds a prime-focus Schmidt. Attesting page must show RASA or Schmidt-camera astrographs sold as a type.

name: Telescope finder
definition: Small sighting device fitted on a telescope tube to aim it: optical finderscope, right-angle finder, red-dot or ring sight; the polar scope is C6.5.1.09.
reason: S3 part made for telescopes, sold under its own name (memo attestation list). Attesting page must show finders sold apart; finder type is an attribute.

name: Barlow lens
definition: Negative lens unit fitted in a telescope's eyepiece barrel that multiplies the effective focal length, and so the magnification, by a stated factor.
reason: S3 part made for telescopes, generic name across makers (memo attestation list). Attesting page must show Barlow lenses sold as a type.

name: Astronomical filter
definition: Filter threaded or mounted for a telescope eyepiece barrel, filter wheel or camera train that passes chosen wavelengths (colour, moon, light-pollution, nebula, narrowband); solar filters are C6.5.1.04.
reason: High Point lists Filters; no part kind holds them. Filter type is an attribute. Attesting page must show eyepiece or nebula filters sold as a type.

name: Microscope objective
definition: Objective lens made to screw into a microscope nosepiece (RMS or M25 thread), sold apart from the stand; objective class and tube-length standard are attributes.
reason: S3 part made for one instrument; UNSPSC lists microscope parts (memo S14). Attesting page must show objectives sold separately.

name: Microscope eyepiece (ocular)
definition: Eyepiece made for a microscope tube (23.2 or 30 mm and other barrels), sold apart from the stand; WF or SWF field and power are attributes.
reason: Not the telescope eyepiece C6.5.1.01: different barrels, instrument served (S3 leaf axis). Attesting page must show microscope eyepieces sold separately.
